# scripts/bundled-cores-exclude.txt
#
# Core slugs to EXCLUDE from the app bundle (one per line). These remain
# downloadable via the in-app catalog. Cores are excluded when their license
# is "Non-commercial" or otherwise restricts redistribution, or when they're
# test/example cores that aren't useful to end users.
#
# Review LICENSE.md (generated by scripts/audit-core-licenses.sh) before
# shipping a release — this list is a starting point, not legal advice.
